capabilities: Preview and validate reference notes in a folder before export
Map note property keys to RIS fields (type, title, authors, year, journal, DOI, URL, abstract)
Export a folder of notes to a new UTF-8 RIS file
Filter exported notes by property value and save named field maps (Pro)
Repeat the last export automatically when mapped fields change (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free core export; Pro features (filters, named maps, repeated export) require a paid GitHub Sponsors sponsorship, one payment unlocks Pro in all NoteMods plugins. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Makes no network requests until sign-in; stores the GitHub token in Obsidian's secret storage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn reference notes with properties into a RIS file that reference managers can import.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Folder-based exporter that maps reference note properties to RIS fields and writes a local .ris file for import into reference managers.
